# Source: Lamp with Hanging Head Dragonfly Shade and Mosaic and Turtleback Base

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Lamp with Hanging Head Dragonfly Shade and Mosaic and Turtleback Base
- **Artist / culture:** Design attributed to Clara Pierce Wolcott Driscoll (American, 1861–1944) Tiffany Studios (American, 1902–32) Corona, New York
- **Date:** By 1906
- **Style:** Arts and Crafts Movement
- **Classification:** lamp (lighting device)
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 185905
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/185905
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/1f36143a-1591-b2a0-f757-20f92438ee5a/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Arts and Crafts

## Extracted source palette

`#484848, #686868, #383828, #586848, #886858, #485828, #182818, #487868`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#1D1D15`
- `surface`: `#373730`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#485828`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#886858`
- `surface_variant`: `#373730`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#5A5A54`
- `error`: `#485828`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `15.94:1`, surface `11.27:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.27:1`
- Control contrast: `7.31:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
